Retail POS FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Does Let's Buy It support electronic weighing scales?

Yes, you can sell items by weight (e.g. per kilogram/gram) for produce, dry fruits, and bulk grocery counters.

What printer paper sizes are supported?

Both standard 80mm (3-inch) and 58mm (2-inch) thermal rolls are supported across USB, LAN network, and Bluetooth ESC/POS printers.
